predecessors.name: Moghulistan
predecessors.text: Kashgar, Yarkand, Khotan, Aksu and Uch Turpan, the Tarim Basin cities held by the Dughlat emir Mirza Abu Bakr, a vassal ruler under Moghulistan, until Sultan Said Khan took them in 1514

successors.name: Dzungar Khanate
successors.text: Altishahr (Tarim Basin) annexed by the Dzungar Khanate (Dzungar conquest of Altishahr infobox)

ledger.x: 1514: Sultan Said Khan takes Kashgar and founds the Yarkent Khanate.

ledger.cp: Turfan Khanate (Chagatayid khans of Turpan after 1570; no dossier)

ledger.x: 1680: the Dzungars annex the Tarim Basin.
1680: the fighting ends in a Dzungar victory (infobox dates 1678-1680).
1680: the Yarkent Khanate loses its independence.

wars.name: Said Khan's conquest of the Dughlat emirate of Kashgar
wars.outcome: Said Khan took Kashgar in May 1514, dethroned Mirza Abu Bakr, and the other cities of the Dughlat state joined him.

wars.name: Said Khan's raids on Bolor, Badakhshan, Ladakh and Kashmir
wars.outcome: Looting expeditions: 'a campaign in Bolor in 1527-1528, a raid into Badakhshan in 1529, and looting expeditions into Ladakh and Kashmir in 1532'; no land gained on the pages opened.

wars.name: Yarkand conquest of Turpan
wars.outcome: Abduraim Sultan, governor of Khotan, invaded in 1570 and 'Turpan came under the control of the Yarkand Khanate'.

wars.name: Dzungar conquest of Altishahr
wars.outcome: Dzungar victory: the Tarim Basin was annexed by the Dzungar Khanate and Abdu'l Rashid II installed as Galdan's vassal.

certainty.note: The Tarim Basin oases are fixed points but the frontiers on the Tian Shan, Kunlun and Pamir sides and the Turfan frontier are approximate; no page opened names a treaty or survey line for the Yarkent Khanate.
